# B2B Lead Growth

> B2B Lead Growth is a founder-run HVAC lead generation and appointment setting service for
> ESTABLISHED residential HVAC companies. It is a monthly service, not a lead seller: no leads
> are sold, resold, or brokered, shared or exclusive, and nothing is priced per lead. It works
> two lanes, kept strictly separate: reactivating demand the client already owns, and referral
> partners researched from cited public sources. It started in 2026 and has no clients,
> testimonials, case studies, or results to publish yet, and publishes none; it never
> guarantees lead counts, replies, appointments, jobs, or revenue.

Last updated: 2026-09-04

## What this is

- A monthly service for established residential HVAC companies. One niche.
- Not a lead seller. Nothing is sold, resold, or brokered per lead.
- Founder-run. The company started in 2026.
- Delivered remotely for HVAC companies across the United States. Campaigns are currently focused on New Jersey.

## Lane 1: reactivation of demand the client already owns

- The records worked are unsold replacement estimates, expired proposals, lapsed maintenance agreements, past customers whose systems are at replacement age, and missed calls.
- These homeowner records come from the client's own export.
- The client approves the list before anything is contacted.
- They are NEVER researched, bought, or inferred. A record claiming to come from the client's list that is not in the approved file is blocked in code.

## Lane 2: referral partners

- The prospects researched are builders, general contractors, property managers, realtors, plumbers, electricians, and home inspectors in the client's service area.
- These are businesses, so they ARE researched from free public sources.
- Every one carries a public source citation, a fit reason, and a confidence note.
- A researched prospect with no citation cannot be contacted.

## How the outreach runs

- Outreach sends from the client's own domain and mailbox.
- The client signs off on targeting, messaging, and the first batch.

## Pricing

- $750 per month: we build the list, the client works it.
- $1,500 per month: we write and send the follow-up.
- $2,500 per month: we also qualify the replies and book the appointments.
- Month-to-month, no setup fee, 14 days' notice to cancel either side.
- The tiers differ only by how much of the work stays in the client's office.

## How someone starts

- The single entry point is the fit check at https://www.b2bleadgrowth.com/start. It returns a straight yes/no on fit.
- It screens out companies the service cannot help (no customer history, wanting to buy homeowner leads, no capacity for more work) rather than booking them a call.
- The entry offer is the Free Pipeline Audit: a sharpened profile of the jobs worth chasing, 3-5 individually vetted and cited referral partners, and one sample outreach message.
- The audit is free and kept regardless of whether the recipient becomes a client. It is delivered IN WRITING; a call is never its price, though a walkthrough is offered afterwards.
- The audit does NOT include homeowner records.

## What this company does not claim

- It has no clients, testimonials, case studies, or results to publish yet, and publishes none.
- It never guarantees lead counts, replies, appointments, jobs, or revenue.
